name: Kerberoasting via SPN Request
description: Detects service ticket requests for SPNs indicating Kerberoasting attempts.

name: DCSync Attack Detection
description: Identifies directory replication requests from non-DC sources.

name: Scheduled Task Creation via CLI
description: Detects scheduled tasks created via schtasks.exe or at.exe command line.

name: LSASS Memory Dump Detection
description: Identifies attempts to dump LSASS process memory for credential harvesting.

name: DNS Tunneling Detection
description: Detects high-entropy DNS queries indicating possible data exfiltration via DNS.

name: Cloud Storage Exfiltration
description: Monitors unusual uploads to cloud storage services outside approved providers.

name: WMI Lateral Movement
description: Detects WMI process creation on remote hosts indicative of lateral movement.

name: Registry Run Key Persistence
description: Monitors modifications to registry run keys for auto-start persistence.

name: Token Impersonation Detection
description: Detects access token manipulation and impersonation attempts.

name: Suspicious Office Macro Execution
description: Identifies Office applications spawning suspicious child processes.
